name: MeTube
description: Web GUI for youtube-dl (using the yt-dlp fork) with playlist support. Allows you to download videos from YouTube and dozens of other sites.

variables.name: Theme
variables.description: Default theme for the web interface

variables.name: Output Template
variables.description: Output template for the downloaded files

variables.name: Output Template - Chapters
variables.description: Output template for the downloaded chapters. Default to OUTPUT_TEMPLATE if empty.

variables.name: Output Template - Playlist
variables.description: Output template for the downloaded playlist. Default to OUTPUT_TEMPLATE if empty.

variables.name: Internal Download Directory
variables.description: Directory where the downloads are stored inside the container

variables.name: Internal Audio Download Directory
variables.description: Directory where the audio downloads are stored inside the container

variables.name: Indexable Download Directories
variables.description: If true, the download dirs (DOWNLOAD_DIR and AUDIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR) are indexable on the webserver.

variables.name: Enable Custom Directory Selection
variables.description: When enabled, a drop-down appears next to the Add button to specify the download directory.

variables.name: Create Custom Directories
variables.description: Automatically create custom directories if they do not exist. When enabled, the download directory selector becomes supports free-text input, and the specified directory will be created recursively.

variables.name: Internal State Directory
variables.description: Where the queue persistence files will be saved

variables.name: Internal Temp Directory
variables.description: Where temporary files will be saved

variables.name: Delete From Filesystem
variables.description: Delete the file from the filesystem when it is removed from the 'Completed' section on the UI.

variables.name: URL Prefix
variables.description: Base path for the web server (for use when hosting behind a reverse proxy)

variables.name: Public Host URL
variables.description: Base URL for the download links shown in the UI for completed files. By default MeTube serves them under its own URL. If your download directory is accessible on another URL and you want the download links to be based there, use this variable to set it.

variables.name: Use SSL
variables.description: Enable HTTPS

variables.name: SSL Certificate
variables.description: Path to the SSL certificate. Required if HTTPS enabled.

variables.name: SSL Key
variables.description: Path to the SSL key. Required if HTTPS enabled.

variables.name: Public Host URL (Audio)
variables.description: Base URL for the audio download links shown in the UI for completed files. By default MeTube serves them under its own URL. If your audio download directory is accessible on another URL and you want the download links to be based there, use this variable to set it.

variables.name: Strict Playlist Mode
variables.description: If true, the 'Strict Playlist mode' switch will be enabled by default. In this mode the playlists will be downloaded only if the URL strictly points to a playlist. URLs to videos inside a playlist will be treated same as direct video URL.

variables.name: Max Number of Playlist Items
variables.description: Maximum number of items to download from a playlist. 0 means no limit.

variables.name: YTDL Options
variables.description: Additional options to pass to youtube-dl

variables.name: YTDL Options File
variables.description: Path to a file containing additional options to pass to youtube-dl

variables.name: Robots.txt File
variables.description: Path to a file containing the robots.txt content
